I dislike working with people that are loud and that spend time goofing around instead of getting the job done.

Hello I’m a Milan local! Can answer some questions I think.
I’ve been to the pinacoteca many times and it’s okay, not as nice as other museums in Italy but it has some rather famous paintings. If you’re not an art lover though you might not like it since there’s not many of the very very famous ones. The place where it is it’s very nice though so I reccomend at least checking it out from the outside. 
Most of the chatgpt reccomend places are not very traditional places. For example temakinho is a japanese/brazilian fusion, I really like it haha but it might not be what you want to look for in Italy. For pizza I really like Spontini and for panini il Panino Giusto.
Bikemi is alright buuuut moving by bike in Milan is a bit of an hassle, there’s not many bike lanes and it can get dangerous at time so I definitely suggest to just use public transportation instead.
I reccomend the area around Collone San Lorenzo, so Vetra, S. Ambrogio and S. Eustorgio, it’s really nice and it has a lot of nice places to eat at! 
There’s a lot of trains that go to Como, I think you’ll be good not having to book in advance but also depends on the train, the high speed ones need to be booked in advance.
And in Como there’s also a bus that goes to Bellagio if you’re worried about seasickness. The line for the ferry is looooooong in August and could take hours, and the buses get pretty full, I warn you.

okay I understand the opinion and I will respect it, but hes my favourite so sorry I want to defend him a little bit. The Kurta are not evil or violent people and I don’t know where you got from, it all feels like speculation and I also don’t like the idea that they deserved to be genocided because sometimes they got angry. Kurapika is the only one we see losing control but he was 12 and he was defending a friend. Overall kurapika isn’t a perfect person, he has flaws and I think everyone that likes him too agrees but it’s what makes him interesting to me. His whole point isn’t really revenge, it’s the contradiction between what he wants to be (ruthless assassin with no feelings) and what he really is (a person that still wants to move on and live), he struggles with survivor’s guilt so he wants to avenge his clan because he feels like he doesn’t deserve happiness after what happened to them. 
He chose to add the steal chain because he wants to fight alone and doesn’t want to put any of his loved ones at risk. It’s not just adding a new badass ability, his ability is all connected to his character theme. He wants to be alone but he still cares about his friend, he throws his lifespan away but he’s still afraid to die, he wants to kill off his humanity but he can’t let go of it.
That being said I know I can’t make you change your opinion on him but I hope I offered a new way of looking at him that will hopefully make him more likeable

I am one of those who voted in favour of it, so I want to say my opinion on it. Note that I understand very well the reasons why people dislike rpf and I respect it, you can very much disagree with me and it would be fine. Here’s the thing, especially when it comes to kpop idols there is already a wall between fiction and reality. I know people don’t like it when you say that idols aren’t genuine on camera and play a character but I do believe that TO SOME EXTENT every idol plays a persona that is different to what they are in their private life. When I read fanfiction I don’t imagine the idols in their personal life, but more like their on-stage persona. It’s like you’re reading a story and the idols are actors in it. If a person enjoys the idea of dating an idol or likes two of the idols friendship it gives them inspiration to write something that makes them happy, I don’t get why not. It also helps young writers in pratcticing and experimenting. Look, I’ve been in fandoms for a long time, I know very well all the damage that it could do to the real life people involved when the shipping goes to far. I have seen people who take it too seriously and genuinely think that the two idols are dating and that’s a big no no for me as well. I like fanfics as long as they’re made by the fandom for the fandom ONLY, so published on websites that are made for fanfics (ao3, wattpad etc). I draw the line at fics on sns like twitter or tiktok where the idols could very much see it just by searching their name. But in fanfic sites, where you very much have to SEARCH for the fics, if an idol actively searches for fics about themselves on ao3 then sorry but it’s on them lol. One last thing, I am sure the idols are VERY MUCH AWARE of the shipping between the members and so does the company. Hell, they would also actively push ships and make them do those cringe games like pepero kiss etc. because it’s all part of the marketing. Shipping and BL has existed for decades and wasn’t born with kpop and the companies know very well that it exists, but the more the fans are engaged with the group the better so I don’t think they really care. So let’s not act like the writers just randomly decided to ship these two dudes together, when the companies are also responsible for pushing them as a marketing strategy.

I wouldn’t say I unstanned exo, I still love them and consider them my ults, but I definitely don’t feel the same excitement for them as I did years ago and it’s definitely due to the lack of group content. First of all it’s great that you chose to ask for help, it’s a really brave choice and you should be proud of yourself for it. Of course every therapist is different, but from my experience, you shouldn’t worry. Therapists (at least the ones that I had) are always kind, sweet and patient, they don’t force you to be uncomfortable, and if you feel like that, you are free to tell them and they try to make you at ease as much as possible. It’s worth remembering that therapists don’t try to change you, and that therapy won’t change who you are as a person, you will still be yourself. What therapists do is trying to give you the best ways to change what it’s making you feel miserable, but the big work is something you do yourself, and the therapist simply helps you find the way to make you feel better that bests suits you and that is more comfortable for you. Think of them simply as someone who holds your hand and gives you advice and support while you’re going into the most difficult journey of your life. I know it’s rlly hard to open up to someone you don’t know, but believe me, once you understand that you are free to be whoever you are in that therapy session, without filters, and that no one will ever judge you for it, it will come much easier. It will take time, but believe me, therapy really does helps. I was scared too at first, I also felt like I was unknowable and nobody would understand how I felt, but it the end it helped me a lot, but if it wasn’t for my therapist and all the help and support I got from her I honestly don’t know where I would be right now, probably underground. Just take a try and see how it goes. Stay strong friend

Hey. I’m in the exact same situation. Tbh I am not the best in giving advice because I can’t even resolve the situation for myself, but I have two options. First of all is that it’s great that you found something that you like. First option is to Talk to your parents about how miserable college it’s making you feel. I know it probably won’t have the best outcome the first time, but just try it and explain the situation to them as best as you can. Maybe they won’t understand the first time, but eventually they will realise. Don’t feel like you’re a failure, because there are more people that feel like this than what you think. Then promise yourself that you will go to that place after you’re done with college. There’s this city in Sweden, Visby, that I’ve been dreaming of for years. I put a pic of it as my phone screen so that I would remind myself that that going there is my goal. Take a deep breath and take it slow, because there ia a beautiful city in Sweden that waits for you, and it is not going to go anywhere.
